meta.name: Tryst With Destiny
meta.description:
A billionaire learns there is something money can't buy, a lower-caste couple attempts to build a new life, and a corrupt city cop finds himself far outside of the law in Nair's slyly biting triptych on class in contemporary India.

Ended · First aired 3 Nov 2021 · India · Language: Hindi
Studio: Drishyam Films, Backup Media · Network: SonyLIV

Complete series. On your server: S1 4/4

On your server — Audio: Hindi

videos.title: Fair and Fine
videos.overview: This is the story of rags-to-riches corporate tycoon Galava and his family. Galava has amassed a vast fortune but still cannot shake off the discrimination that comes with a dark complexion in a colonial hangover culture that is so obsessed with all things white. In a darkly comic fashion, Galava decides to force an elite Parsi businessman who owns a large debt to him, to marry his very fair and handsome son to Galava's daughter Madhavi.

videos.title: The River
videos.overview: This is the story of Gautam and Ahalya, a lower caste couple who live in the small village of Shahabpur in northern Uttar Pradesh. Dealing with the abject poverty that comes with a lower caste life, Gautam and Ahalya work hard to provide for their family. However, Ahalya is repeatedly raped by some of the upper caste men in the village, who consider lower caste bodies as their own property. One day, Gautam ends up murdering his wife's rapists and the family flees to Delhi to escape the village's wrath.

videos.title: One BHK
videos.overview: The story is of Senior Constable Kubera and his paramour Laxmi, who have aspirations of owning an apartment in the bustling and expensive city of Bombay. This story is Kubera's quest to manage the cash for paying the down payment of a flat that he wants to buy for the love of his life. From being a small-time unethical cop to burgling a whole jewellery shop, this story throws light on the rampant corruption that Infects India's whole fabric.

videos.title: A Beast Within
videos.overview: A man wanting to avenge his son's death, who was eaten by a tiger, plans to take the law in his hand while a forest officer reaches the spot to take the tiger out safely, which the villagers have captured and kept in a crate.
